mapper.select: SELECT dv.id, dv.document_id, d.work_case_id, dv.version_no, dv.version_type, dv.storage_key, dv.mime_type, dv.checksum FROM document_versions dv JOIN documents d ON d.id = dv.document_id WHERE dv.document_id = #{documentId} AND dv.version_type = 'SIGNED' AND dv.version_no = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM documents d JOIN work_contracts wc ON wc.work_case_id = d.work_case_id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND (wc.employer_id = #{userId} OR wc.worker_id = #{userId})
